case_evidence.description: Frozen Python 1.2 src/eyetrajectoriespy/plotting.py::plot_fpca_outlier_diagnostics; native etr_plot_fpca_outlier_diagnostics(...,strict_source_record=TRUE) is a deliberately bounded source-geometry port.
Native etr_fpca_outliers containing finite diagnostics review_flag, per-row score_cutoff and optional finite reconstruction_z_threshold; strict mode refuses invented Python data identity.

Scatter offsets equal original diagnostic robust-z and Mahalanobis columns. Vertical source reconstruction-z threshold is optional, horizontal first score cutoff mandatory. Direct pinned Python 1.2 Matplotlib PathCollection offsets and reference Line2D values compared.
Rejects nonnative result, malformed columns, missing flags, negative cutoff, nonfinite threshold and nonlogical strict mode; Python exception classes not claimed.

One-panel typed native R scatter and reference-line source scientific record, source title and labels; Python returns Matplotlib Axes, whose runtime identity and pixels are outside this scoped review.
Source robust-z reconstruction versus squared FPC Mahalanobis distance with original trajectory flags and thresholds, without recalculation or classification.
